toegepas.voor: 'n Gewerwelde dier se geraamte lyk so.
toegepas.na: So lyk 'n gewerwelde dier se geraamte.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The block opens three sentences with the same subject; fronting 'So' reads more naturally and links back to the definition just given.
toegepas.fout: The block opens a second sentence with the same long subject, and 'lyk so' at the end links back to the definition only loosely.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Fronting 'So' is the natural Afrikaans order, ties the sentence to the definition just given and avoids the repeated opening without moving the meaning.

toegepas.na: binne-in wat die krap ophou nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: After a sentence naming both the shell and the animal, 'hom' could point to either; naming the crab removes the doubt.
toegepas.fout: 'hom' follows a sentence naming both the shell and the animal, so it could point to either.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the crab removes the ambiguity, keeps the intended meaning and leaves the protected 'geen raam van bene' intact.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat die raam vir die dier doen
laat_vaar.voor: tussen die ribbes van die ribbekas deurkyk en ook tussen die lang bene van 'n poot
laat_vaar.na: tussen die ribbes van die ribbekas en ook tussen die lang bene van 'n poot deurkyk
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The second place you can look through trails after the verb; putting both places before 'deurkyk' gives the sentence one clean verb at the end.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing the second phrase after the verb is natural Afrikaans; the proposal pushes the verb far to the end and is harder for a Grade 5 reader.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wat 'n raam binne 'n ander dier doen
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wat 'n raam binne-in 'n ander dier doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'binne-in' is the form the lesson uses everywhere else for inside the body, and reads more naturally here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Binne 'n ander dier' is natural and pairs with 'buite in plaas van binne' in the next sentence; the swap is lateral.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'nou' reads as a time word (as if the strength moved); 'hier' means 'in this case', which is the intended contrast.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Contrastive 'nou' reads naturally, while 'hier buite' reads as the fixed phrase 'out here' and moves the sense.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: Dan word die nuwe dop hard
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Daardie dop' could point back to the old shell just mentioned; 'die nuwe dop' makes the reference clear and the word order is more natural.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Daardie dop' points to the new shell named in the sentence just before, and the proposal repeats 'nuwe' twice in one sentence.
